items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: But I tell you who played me a long time, Happy Goldston. He took Chinese plays, see. I kept him when I got him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to blow me up a lot of times. But I tell you who played me a long time, Happy Goldston. He took Chinese plays, see. I kept him when I got him. That's before he went to the tuxedo.
Well, Chinese was with the tuxedo.

items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: After Jesse Jackson, I went at Punch. I stayed at Punch a long time here. I left Punch.

ctx.x: old could go on a dance nowadays. You know that. Yeah. And I played with Punch. A long time. Kid Punch. That was Punch's band here, huh? Yeah, that was Punch's band. Was that after Jesse Jackson

or before? No. After Jesse Jackson, I went at Punch. I stayed at Punch a long time here. I left Punch. I went with this same band here. Ridgely's Tuxedo. With Baby Eric. And after one of the the, this is, this is the band, I started reading it. This band there. And the reason of this band, Ridgely and Celestine, they made up the Tuxedo band years ago. And they stayed together and they had a falling out about one dollar. One dollar. Broke those two men. And so, so, so, so they had a split and Ridgely. And Ridgely…

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: He took the Chinese place with me, you know.

ctx.x: The one uptown now. He took the Chinese place with me, you know.
